hints.title: Inverting Parent-Child Pointers Along Path
hints.text: Only pointers along the ancestral path from leaf to the original root are modified. Other subtrees remain unchanged.

hints.title: Child Reassignment Rules
hints.text: For node curr on the path, if curr had a left child, that child moves to become curr right child. The original parent becomes curr left child.

hints.title: Disconnecting Ancestor Link
hints.text: Clear the parent pointer from its previous reference to curr before recursively rerooting the parent.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: H: depth of the leaf node
complexity.notes: Iterates upward along the single ancestral path from leaf to root, requiring constant auxiliary memory.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Full tree reconstruction requires extra memory and breaks in-place pointer modification requirements.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Local pointer manipulation along ancestral path achieves optimal O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Careful pointer rewiring with left-to-right promotion and parent clearing.
